scope: Europe (including transcontinental states commonly treated in European numismatic searches: Russia, Turkey, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan) + Kosovo + microstates + United States; current currencies plus major modern/pre-euro national currencies and common numismatic aliases.
design_rule: High recall during input normalization, high precision during final identity validation.
sources_note: Country/currency periods should be extended over time for deeper historical coverage. Current euro-area status aligned to 2026.
